subject: English
passage:
[Table 1]

A study by Farhan Santoso and Sibusiso Okafor of commercial shipping lanes that carried the greatest volume of freight in 2020 and 2021 shows that, in general, domestic lanes (lanes within a single country) carried far more cargo than international lanes. However, a few international lanes were so heavily used that they handled more freight than some of the most active domestic lanes, as can be seen when comparing the ______
prompt: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the example?

choices.A: lane length between Houston and New Orleans with the lane length between Singapore and Tokyo.
choices.B: amount of cargo carried between Shanghai and Guangzhou in 2020 with the amount carried between Singapore and Tokyo during that same year.
choices.C: amount of cargo carried between Singapore and Tokyo in 2020 with the amount carried along that same lane in 2021.
choices.D: amount of cargo carried between Rotterdam and New York in 2021 with the amount carried between Shanghai and Guangzhou during that same year.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The passage states that although domestic lanes generally carried more cargo than international lanes, a few international lanes carried more freight than some of the most active domestic lanes. According to the table, the Rotterdam-New York lane (an international lane) handled 182.4 million metric tons of cargo in 2021, while the Shanghai-Guangzhou lane (a domestic lane) handled 154.7 million metric tons during that same year. This comparison illustrates an international lane carrying more cargo than a domestic lane.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because it compares the same lane (Singapore-Tokyo) across two different years rather than comparing an international lane with a domestic lane. The passage requires a comparison that demonstrates an international lane carrying more cargo than a domestic lane.
